# Error codes

Generated from `crates/rustinfer-core/src/error.rs` and each crate's
`src/error.rs` at commit 082df51 2026-11-10. A failure leaves the command as one line on
stderr, `error=<code> component=<name> detail="<text>"`, and the code column
below is the wire value. The source marks the enum `#[non_exhaustive]` and says
a class may be added but never renamed (SWG-001 §14.4).

## Codes

| variant | wire value | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `config` | Invalid or missing configuration or settings. |
| `Usage` | `usage` | Invalid command-line usage. |
| `NotFound` | `not_found` | A path or file that does not exist or cannot be accessed. |
| `Io` | `io` | An I/O failure. |
| `Invalid` | `invalid` | Input that could not be parsed or validated at a boundary. |
| `Unsupported` | `unsupported` | A requested model, format, target or feature combination is not supported. |
| `NotImplemented` | `not_implemented` | A feature specified in the SRS but not yet implemented in this release. |
| `Artifact` | `artifact` | The artifact failed an integrity or compatibility check. |
| `Device` | `device` | A device or driver failure. |
| `Internal` | `internal` | An invariant that should never fail did; a bug. |

## Variants per crate

The component column is the `COMPONENT` constant the crate prints. *delegated*
means the variant carries another crate's error and reports that crate's code
and component.
